name: Timeline Time Selection
description: Perfetto-style timeline interaction for click-to-select events, pointer-drag time ranges, a cross-track selection band, exact time summaries, modifier-wheel zoom dispatch, and keyboard horizontal navigation.

source.visualContract: Perfetto area and event selection behavior adapted to PTO token and interaction contracts

useWhen: Selecting a continuous time interval on a timeline or swimlane surface.
Showing exact start, end, and duration values for a selected event or range.
Dispatching cursor-anchored Ctrl/Command-wheel zoom and keyboard horizontal navigation.
forbiddenOverrides: modifier-wheel interception outside the interaction target
danger color for ordinary time selection
agentReuseRule: Load pattern.css and pattern.js, bind interactions through window.PtoTimelineTimeSelectionPattern.bindTimelineInteraction, and render the shared selection layer and summary. Business pages own trace data and zoom state but must not duplicate pointer capture, click-versus-drag, time conversion, or selection overlay behavior.
